decisive_items: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar was negative
response.rationale: The intracellular yeasts with a halo and positive fungal special stains are pathognomonic for histoplasmosis, whereas chronic granulomatous disease is a generic description lacking the specific fungal morphology. Negative culture is consistent with histoplasmosis in tissue sections.

rejected.why: The mixed infiltrate is nonspecific and does not account for the intracellular yeast forms and fungal stains, which are decisive for histoplasmosis.
